items.label: p1_1_physics (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.1 experiment: sanity metrics for nondimensionalisation, analytic solutions and MMS. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_2_fd1d (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.2: 1D FD verification — spatial order of every convection scheme, temporal order of every integrator, all BC types, Case B (Robin + source + fin) against the eigen-series solution. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_3_stability (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.3: stability & accuracy analysis. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_4_spectral (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.4: Chebyshev spectral collocation (exponential convergence, Robin via row replacement) and an independent SciPy method-of-lines (BDF/Radau) cross-check of the FD solver and time integrators. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_5_fvm2d (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.5: 2D finite-volume energy solver verification and solver performance. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_6_ns (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.6: 2D incompressible Navier–Stokes on a MAC grid (projection method) — verification + demos. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_7_benchmarks (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.7: validation benchmarks + three-grid GCI (Celik procedure, Fs = 1.25). Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p1_7_verification (verified solvers)
items.about: Step 1.7: verification summary and Phase-1 gate table. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p2_data (data)
items.about: Phase 2: generate datasets from USER-DEFINABLE conditions (defaults in configs/data/defaults.yaml).

items.label: p3_pinn1d (1D PINN)
items.about: Phase 3 (Step 3.4): baseline 1D PINN validation on Cases A and B across user-defined parameter grids.

items.label: p3_report (1D PINN)
items.about: Failure-mode table for Phase 3. Every claim is a measurement; diagnosis wording depends on what was measured. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p4_1_architectures (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.1: architecture comparison for the 1D PINN (plain MLP, Fourier features with tuned sigma, modified MLP, residual blocks, random weight factorisation, SIREN) on user-defined (problem, parameter) cases.

items.label: p4_2_diagnostics (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.2 diagnostics (saved metrics for two observations of the formulation study). Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p4_2_formulations (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.2: 2D formulations - primitive (u,v,p,theta) vs stream function (psi,p,theta), hard-constraint BCs, pressure gauge and residual normalisation - on a manufactured solution (exact truth) and the heated lid-driven cavity (truth: steady Newton FV reference on two grids).

items.label: p4_3_balancing (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.3: loss-balancing suite - fixed, learning-rate annealing, GradNorm, NTK-trace, SoftAdapt, ReLoBRaLo, uncertainty weighting and self-adaptive weights - on 1D (analytic truth) and 2D (exact MMS / Newton FV truth) cases.

items.label: p4_4_strategies (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.4: sampling and training strategies - Sobol / random / LHS collocation, random resampling, residual-based adaptive sampling (RAD, RAR-D), causal temporal weighting, time-marching, curriculum in Pe/Re, and optimiser strategies (Adam schedule, gradient clipping, with/without L-BFGS) - on 1D and 2D cases.

items.label: p4_5_parametric (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.5a: parametric 2D training on Case C - ONE network with (x, y, log Re, log Pr, log Bi [, Ri]) inputs over the Phase 2 Case C parameter range, evaluated on the Phase 2 interpolation and extrapolation test points against steady FV references (Phase 1 solver), compared with one non-parametric network per test point.

items.label: p4_5b_channel (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.5b: parametric 2D training on Case D - the thermally developing channel (Graetz, Robin walls) and the channel with a heated square cylinder - with (x, y, log Re, log Pr, log Bi) inputs; one parametric network per case vs one network per test point; test points from a parameter design (interp inside, extrap outside the training box); references = Phase 1 steady solver on two grids.

items.label: p4_5b_diagnostics (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.5b diagnostics: mass conservation of the trained channel PINNs. Reloads the final networks saved by a p4_5b_channel run (runs/*/checkpoint.pt, phase 'done') with the run's own config and design, and evaluates the PINN flow rate Q = int u dy at the inlet and outlet at every design point (aerosynapse.thermal.pinn.channel2d.flow_rates). The exact flow conserves mass, so Q_out / Q_in = 1; a rat Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p4_6_hybrid (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.6: hybrid data + physics vs data-free vs data-only on the Case D channels; how little data suffices.

items.label: p4_7_ablation (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.7: ablation of the Phase 4 recipe — leave-one-out and add-one-in, >= 3 seeds, mean +- std, training time vs accuracy.

items.label: p4_gate (2D PINN)
items.about: Phase 4 gate: (G1) 2D PINN results vs the Phase 1 solver on the interpolation-test parameters (compiled from the saved Phase 4 study runs), (G2) the ablation table (Step 4.7), (G3) benchmark comparison with new physics-only PINN runs: Ghia et al. cavity centreline profiles (Re 100, uniform lid), the Graetz constant-wall-temperature Nusselt number (parallel plates, with axial conduction) and the de

items.label: p4_report (2D PINN)
items.about: Step 4.1 report: architecture comparison table. All statements are measurements; wording depends on the evidence. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_1_identifiability (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.1: identifiability of (alpha, k, h) BEFORE any training — sensitivity Jacobian, Fisher information, SVD / condition number, Cramer-Rao lower bounds — for the dimensional 1D body (slab / cylinder / sphere) of configs/inverse/defaults.yaml. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_2_diagnostics (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.2 diagnostics: why the inverse PINNs miss the parameters. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_2_pinn_inverse (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.2: PINN inverse identification of (alpha, k, h) — log-parameters, joint vs two-stage training, data vs physics loss weighting — on the 1D body of configs/inverse/defaults.yaml (slab by default; cylinder / sphere selectable). Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_3_classical (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.3: classical baseline — weighted least squares (SciPy) with the FDM forward solver, for (alpha, k, h). Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_4_robustness (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.4: noise robustness (sigma = 0, 1, 2, 5, 10 %), sensor number and sensor placement. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_5_uq (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.5: parameter uncertainty quantification. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_6_confounding (inverse problems)
items.about: Step 5.6: confounding cases — when k and h are separable, when they are not, and what helps; reported honestly. Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p5_gate (inverse problems)
items.about: Phase 5 gate: recovered parameters with % error and confidence bands vs the Cramer-Rao bound and vs the classical baseline; parameter-convergence plots. Aggregates the SAVED metrics of Steps 5.1-5.6 (no new training or fitting): Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p6_1_scaling (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.1: convergence / scaling of the PINN — error vs width, depth, collocation points and training epochs; fitted power laws; PINN vs mesh solvers (FD, Chebyshev) at equal error.

items.label: p6_2_uq (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.2: predictive uncertainty of parametric 1D PINNs — deep ensembles, MC-dropout, calibration, conformal.

items.label: p6_3_extrapolation (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.3: extrapolation and validity — inside vs outside the trained range, truth-free validity indicators, and an explicit, LABELLED study beyond the laminar regime.

items.label: p6_4_extended (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.4b: solver cost and grid convergence (with a prediction for a large TARGET grid, e.g. 1024 x 1024), and the 2D / 3D figures of the Step 6.4 sensitivity study.

items.label: p6_4_sensitivity (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.4: global sensitivity — Sobol indices of mean Nu w.r.t. Re, Pr, Bi from the PINN surrogate, cross-checked against the verified FV solver (Monte Carlo and polynomial chaos).

items.label: p6_5_diagnostics (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.5: why a PINN trains or fails — spectral bias, NTK eigen-spectrum, Hessian and loss landscape.

items.label: p6_6_validation (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.6: physical validation in 2D — Nusselt numbers vs Re / Pe / Ra against correlations verified from sources.

items.label: p6_6b_2d (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.6b: the Phase 6 analyses of Steps 6.2 (UQ), 6.3 (extrapolation) and 6.5 (training diagnostics) on the saved 2D parametric networks, against the verified 2D FV solver (solutions cached on disk and reused).

items.label: p6_7_cost (analysis)
items.about: Step 6.7: cost analysis — training time, inference latency, hardware stated, break-even number of queries vs the solver, for the project's saved PARAMETRIC networks (2D: Graetz channel ensemble of Step 4.7, heated cavity variants of Step 4.5a; 1D: the Step 6.2 deep ensembles of A_steady and B_slab).

items.label: p6_gate (analysis)
items.about: Phase 6 gate: tables + figures + a written limitations section, all traced to RESULTS_REGISTRY.

items.label: p6b_g1_stats (gap runs)
items.about: Step 6B.2b gap run G1 (paper/PREREG_G1_G3.md): statistics of the Step 4.7 ablation at 5 seeds (no training). Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p6b_g2_conflict (gap runs)
items.about: Step 6B.2b gap run G2 (paper/PREREG_G1_G3.md): is gradient conflict lower in failing PINN runs? (5 seeds) Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: p6b_g3_budget (gap runs)
items.about: Step 6B.2b gap run G3 (paper/PREREG_G1_G3.md): is the smoke-budget error floor budget-limited? Runs with its own fixed settings.

items.label: run airfrans

items.label: run phase1
items.about: Phase 1: convergence / verification study for all Level-1 solvers -> results/phase1_verification.

items.label: run phase2
items.about: Phase 2: PINN benchmarks vs exact solutions, supervised baseline, BC strategies, loss imbalance.

items.label: run phase3
items.about: Phase 3: equal-budget adaptive-collocation study for transient conv-diff across Pe (multi-seed).

items.label: run phase3 extras
items.about: Phase 3 extras for figures: (a) PINN space-time fields + final collocation points at several Pe (Fig. C); (b) collocation-budget sweep (Pe × budget × sampler, Fig. D).

items.label: run phase4
items.about: Phase 4: neural operators, hybrids, UQ (see aerosynapse.experiments.studies.phase4).

items.label: run phase4 genmap
items.about: Phase 4 generalisation map (Fig. G): the trained FNO from phase4_operators_uq evaluated over (Pe, input bandwidth).

items.label: run phase5
items.about: Phase 5: optimisation engine and inverse problems (see aerosynapse.experiments.studies.phase5).

items.label: run phase6
items.about: Phase 6: fluid mechanics and aerospace (see aerosynapse.experiments.studies.phase6).

items.label: run phase7
items.about: Phase 7: validation engine — trust/fallback, trust reports, resource estimator, notebooks.

items.label: run quality gate
items.about: Quality gate: full test suite with coverage, ruff, mypy -> results/quality_gate/metrics.json.

items.label: audit claims
items.about: Claims audit: every number quoted in README, summaries, docs and the paper must match a value in a results/<id>/metrics.json (or record.json) artifact, up to the precision quoted.

items.label: check paper
items.about: Validate the LaTeX sources without a TeX toolchain: \input targets exist, \cite keys are in references.bib, \ref targets have labels, \includegraphics files exist, braces balance. Exit 1 on any problem.

items.label: make aircraft report
items.about: Build the whole-aircraft comparison page from results/aircraft/study.json.

items.label: make architecture
items.about: Generate docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: hand-written overview + an auto-generated index of every module and its public classes/functions (first docstring line), so the document cannot drift from the code.

items.label: make fighter report
items.about: Build the fighter study page from the saved results (every number comes from a file under results/).

items.label: make figures
items.about: Generate all figures from results/ (deterministic). Writes paper/figures/manifest.json.

items.label: make report
items.about: Generate paper/tables/*.tex and docs/RESULTS_TABLES.md directly from results/ (no hand-typed numbers).

items.label: make reproducibility
items.about: Write docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md from the experiment records (measured wall-clock, versions, hardware).

items.label: make shapeopt report
items.about: Build the baseline-versus-optimised comparison page from the results on disk.

items.label: reproduce all
items.about: Reproduce every reported result: run all phase studies, then figures, the paper tables and the claims audit.
